lessons.title: Getting around
objectives: Use take and get with common transport and destinations.
Use transport phrases in one short, clear everyday exchange.

content_sections.title: Language focus
content_sections.body: In lesson 41: transport phrases, notice this model: We take the bus to town and get off near the museum. Keep the word order short and make the meaning clear.
